title: Home-services competitors | Dominican Republic & Colombia

companies.name: Servicio.do
companies.areas: Advertises Santo Domingo, Punta Cana, Santiago and other RD zones; availability not tested.
companies.services: Repairs, home maintenance, remodeling and broader local services.
companies.journey: Post a job, compare up to three quotes, select a provider and review completed work.
companies.trust: Application review and reputation tools advertised; app listing describes narrower checks than a general verified badge.
companies.trigger: Monthly plan plus confirmed completed job.
companies.pricing: USD 0–149.99/month published tiers; 10% per completed job, capped at USD 100/job; enterprise by agreement.
companies.payments: Platform fees paid by bank transfer against invoice; no automatic card collection stated.
companies.strength: Combines recurring revenue with outcome-linked income.
companies.weakness: Dual charges can be harder to sell; completion reporting creates collection work.
companies.lesson: Benchmark capped commissions and three-provider competition, but simplify pilot pricing.
companies.caveat: Professional page says three plans while pricing lists seven. Linked Punta Cana Work app describes monthly listings; confirm current contract and brand transition.

companies.name: MANO
companies.areas: Santiago de los Caballeros launch announced.
companies.services: Plumbing, electricity, carpentry and air conditioning.
companies.journey: Free customer requests; professionals spend credits to unlock opportunities; up to three proposals.
companies.trust: Identity/work evidence checks and completed-job reviews advertised.
companies.pricing: Credit tariff not published; introductory free-work offer advertised.
companies.payments: Job-payment and credit-purchase arrangements not verified.
companies.strength: Low operating involvement in job payment; providers choose opportunities.
companies.weakness: Lead quality and responsiveness determine willingness to pay.
companies.lesson: Watch the local credit model; test refund rules before charging.
companies.caveat: Waitlist language signals launch preparation, not verified operating volume.

companies.name: Reno RD
companies.areas: Lists Santo Domingo, Santiago, Punta Cana and northern/eastern cities.
companies.services: Trades, repairs, cleaning and broader local services.
companies.journey: Submit text, voice or photos; receive options; coordinate through the platform.
companies.trust: Provider verification and controlled contact release advertised.
companies.model: Category commission; subscription in selected categories
companies.trigger: Confirmed job; monthly agreement for subscription categories.
companies.pricing: Category-specific percentage shown to provider, not publicly quantified. Agreement offers first three confirmed jobs without commission.
companies.payments: Cash/direct transfers can require weekly fee settlement; platform withholding is conditional on in-app payments being available.
companies.strength: Can support locally preferred payment methods.
companies.weakness: Off-platform settlement and fee enforcement create operational friction.
companies.lesson: Contact gating alone cannot solve collection; design reconciliation first.
companies.caveat: Founder incentive deadline in the agreement was November 1, 2026 and has passed; do not assume it remains available.

companies.name: SuperVecino RD
companies.areas: Playa Nueva Romana identified as pilot; residential-community focus.
companies.services: Plumbers, electricians, pool maintenance and residential services.
companies.journey: Find a provider and contact directly; job codes support reviews.
companies.trust: Identity/reference checks and community reviews advertised.
companies.model: Provider directory plans; no job commission advertised
companies.pricing: First paid-plan month advertised as free; exact recurring amounts not visible in retrieved content.
companies.payments: Customer contacts provider directly; payment workflow not verified.
companies.strength: Dense residential communities can reduce acquisition costs.
companies.weakness: Listing value depends on traffic and useful local supply.
companies.lesson: Residential administrators could be a focused Santo Domingo acquisition channel.
companies.caveat: Pilot and broader community-reach claims were not independently verified.

companies.name: Corotos
companies.areas: Dominican Republic; categories include businesses and services.
companies.journey: Find an advertiser and contact directly rather than run a job-specific quote process.
companies.trust: Paid seller tools include account verification and professional profiles.
companies.pricing: Basic/Pro/Premium and boosts described; comparable current service-category rate not verified.
companies.payments: Recurring seller-plan billing described in terms; job-payment handling not established.
companies.strength: Established discovery channel with broad category reach.
companies.weakness: Less structured around contractor selection and job outcomes.
companies.lesson: Offer job tracking and meaningful reviews beyond a contact listing.
companies.caveat: Not a like-for-like contractor lead marketplace; traffic leadership claims were not audited.

companies.name: Servi (servird.do)
companies.services: Plumbing, cleaning, electrical and other home services.
companies.journey: Proposed company search, quote comparison, scheduling and protected in-app payment.
companies.trust: Company verification and payment protection promised.
companies.payments: Protected in-app payment described as a planned capability.
companies.weakness: Commercial and fulfillment capability cannot yet be established from the waitlist.
companies.lesson: Monitor launch and verification offer before treating it as proven competition.
companies.caveat: Distinct from servi.vrd.do; similar names must not be combined.

companies.name: Solverio
companies.status: Public app listing and tariff page
companies.areas: Cali; Medellín/Valle de Aburrá; Bogotá/Sabana, according to site.
companies.services: Plumbing, electrical, painting, cleaning, carpentry, locks and other household trades.
companies.journey: Customer requests work, receives priced proposals, chooses and coordinates in chat.
companies.trust: Document/selfie/background review and customer ratings advertised.
companies.model: Pay per proposal; additional winning-proposal fee for companies
companies.payer: Independent professional or registered company; customer use free.
companies.trigger: Proposal submission; company winner also pays percentage.
companies.pricing: COP 1,500–2,500/proposal; 0% job commission for individuals; companies with NIT pay 3% on winning proposal.
companies.payments: Service payment direct to provider; proposal credits prepaid.
companies.strength: Transparent low entry spend and control over opportunity selection.
companies.weakness: Providers pay even when another wins; requires reliable demand and clear refunds.
companies.lesson: Closest published Colombian proposal-fee benchmark for a lightweight pilot.
companies.caveat: Published rules support refunds on cancellation/no selection, not when another professional wins. Scale not independently established.

companies.name: AYDA
companies.areas: Examples include Bogotá, Cali, Medellín, Barranquilla, Santa Marta and Cartagena; category/address dependent.
companies.services: Repairs, installation, remodeling, cleaning and complementary services.
companies.journey: Select scope, schedule, pay and follow service status.
companies.trust: Provider selection/training and service-specific guarantees advertised.
companies.payer: Customer buys service; provider pays platform percentage.
companies.pricing: Commission percentage undisclosed. Electrician quotation visit advertised from COP 24,900.
companies.payments: Platform checkout through PayU; quote approval precedes additional work.
companies.weakness: More support, scope and dispute handling than introductions alone.
companies.lesson: Separate a diagnostic visit from the eventual repair price.
companies.caveat: COP 24,900 is a quotation-visit entry price, not a full repair or provider lead fee. Check service-specific conditions.

companies.name: Hogarú
companies.status: Public booking products and app listing
companies.areas: Bogotá/Sabana, Medellín and Cali listed by developer.
companies.journey: Reserve cleaning visits; assigned professional performs the booked service.
companies.trust: Trained staff and employment-benefit administration advertised for cleaning offering.
companies.trigger: Booked service / recurring schedule; separate administration product.
companies.pricing: Four/eight-hour formats advertised; current comparable public tariff not verified.
companies.payments: Advance payment described for reservation; operational service delivery is central.
companies.strength: Recurring demand and operational consistency can support retention.
companies.weakness: Staffing and service operations are substantially heavier than selling introductions.
companies.lesson: Use as an operational-quality benchmark, not a lead-price benchmark.
companies.caveat: Retail revenue model is evident; internal margin is inferred and not publicly quantified. Do not reuse old newspaper prices.

companies.name: Homecenter / Sodimac Colombia
companies.areas: Multiple Colombian cities; availability varies by service and address.
companies.journey: Buy a defined service SKU and arrange fulfillment.
companies.trust: Installer screening, training and service guarantee described.
companies.pricing: Example: COP 86,900 for a four-hour handyman SKU (310473).
companies.payments: Retail checkout; provider commercial share not disclosed.
companies.strength: Retail distribution and defined scopes reduce discovery friction.
companies.weakness: Scope exclusions and retailer-product conditions limit flexibility.
companies.lesson: Standardize small jobs after learning common pilot scopes.
companies.caveat: Retail service price, not a platform fee. Materials excluded; check listed coverage/product conditions. Internal margin is an inference.
